sanskrit: yāḥ senā abhītvarīr āvyādhinīr ugaṇā uta | ya steno yaś ca taskaras tāṃs te agne 'pi dadhāmy āsani ||
english: Those armies that press forward fiercely, those that shoot all around, the violent hordes as well — the thief and the robber likewise — these I deliver into your mouth, O Agni.

sanskrit: jambhair malimlūn agne daṃṣṭrābhyāṃ taskārān uta | hanūbhyāṃ stenān maghavan tāṃs tvaṃ khāda sukhāditān ||
english: With your jaws, O Agni, crush the brigands; with your fangs, the robbers as well; with your two jawbones, the thieves, O bountiful one — devour them, well-consumed.

sanskrit: ye grāmeṣu malimluca stenāsas taskarā vane | ye kakṣeṣv aghāyavas tāṃs te 'gne 'pi dadhāmy āsani ||
english: Those brigands and thieves in the villages, the robbers in the forest, those who contrive evil in the thickets — these I deliver into your mouth, O Agni.

sanskrit: yo asmabhyam arātīyād yaś ca no dveṣad ij janaḥ | āmādaḥ kravyādo ripūṃs tān agne saṃ dahā tvam ||
english: Whoever acts with hostility toward us, and whatever person hates us — those enemies who devour the raw flesh and feed on carrion — burn them up utterly, O Agni.

sanskrit: ā krandaya dhanapata ud enam ardayāmutaḥ | arvañcaṃ punar ā kṛdhi yathāhaṃ kāmaye tathā ||
english: Make him cry out, O lord of wealth; torment him and drive him back from that place. Turn him around, bring him back here — just as I desire, so make it be.

sanskrit: parisartaḥ pari dhāva- -ākartaḥ punar ā kṛdhi | atho ma indraś cāgniś ca- -amum ā nayatām iha ||
english: Run around, go in circles — and having circled, bring him back here again. Furthermore, let Indra and Agni bring that one back to me here.

sanskrit: ekārka ekakāmāya yasmai kāmāya khāyase | tena me viśvadhāvīrya- -amum ā nayatād iha ||
english: The single Arka plant — for the single desire for which you are dug up — with that all-pervading power of yours, bring that one back to me here.

sanskrit: yatrayatra carantaṃ nyamraug abhi sūryaḥ | tato me pathye revaty amum ā nayatād iha ||
english: Wherever that one wanders, the sun shines down upon him from above — from that place, let the prosperous goddess of the road bring that one back to me here.

sanskrit: asitasya taimātasya babhror apodakasya ca | sarvā viṣasya dhāmāny udnevāgnim avīvare ||
english: All the abodes of the venom — of the dark serpent, of the Taimāta snake, of the brown one, of the waterless one — I have quenched them as one quenches fire with water.

sanskrit: iṣīkādanta durlabha kiṃ me sakhāyam ātudaḥ | na mām apaśya āgataṃ satīnaṃ viṣadūṣaṇam ||
english: O reed-toothed one, hard to grasp — why have you stung my companion? Did you not see me coming, the true poisoner-of-poison?

sanskrit: yat tālavye dati saṃsisikṣe viṣaṃ tvam | trayas tudā rujāmasi babhruko nakulas tvat ||
english: The venom that you have sprayed with your palatal tooth — the three piercers, we break it: the brown mongoose strikes you from the front.

sanskrit: trayo vai smaḥ sakhāyo babhruko nakulas tvat | te sarve apy apātayann āheyam arasaṃ viṣam ||
english: We three are indeed companions — the brown one, the mongoose, against you. All of them together have brought down the serpent's venom, making it sapless.
